title: Odd-Triple Basis Audit
basis_rule_summary: choose 40 independent columns P; each remaining column c gives a relation with pivot coefficients -P^{-1}c and coefficient 1 on c
architecture_upgrade: CCCLXV found the 4480-column odd-triple incidence space has rank 40. CCCLXVII gives a constructive pivot/free-column certificate and verifies sample relations exactly over rational arithmetic.
honesty_boundary: The repository stores the reproducible construction rule and sample checks rather than all 4440 generated relations.
